_readme: The seventeen engagements from FELMOS PRESENTATION.pptx, the company's own
brief of its work. Photographs live in ./deck (gitignored) and are named by
- client, year and location are transcribed from the report title pages
photographed in the deck. Where a project has no title page in the deck,
they are null — nothing here is inferred or estimated.
- title and copy are the deck's own wording, corrected for spelling and
set in sentence case. No claim was added that the deck does not make.
- duration, result and metric are absent from the source entirely and are
- report title pages, structural drawings and location screenshots were
extracted but are deliberately not listed here. They carry client
reference numbers, signatures and laboratory stamps, and belong in a
report rather than on a public gallery.
- the equipment photographs on slide 30 are vendor product shots for
third-party instruments, so they are not imported at all.
_serviceImagesReadme: Service slug -> a photograph imported below, replacing the Unsplash/Pexels
stock the services page launched with. Real work beats a stock photo of
someone else's building, and these are already on the volume.
The same media row ends up referenced twice — once as a service image, once
in a project gallery. That is intentional and safe: deleteIfUnused checks
both, so neither reference can be removed out from under the other.
structural-drawings is deliberately absent. The only drawings in the brief
are the annotated column-layout sheets from the reports, which carry client
markings and reference numbers, and no photograph of an engineer with a
clipboard honestly says 'we produce structural drawings'. It keeps its stock
image until there is a real one.

projects.title: Tafawa Balewa Square
projects.scope: Non-destructive integrity testing of every structural member across Nigeria's foremost ceremonial ground.
projects.narrative: Built in 1972 and holding over 55,000 people, Tafawa Balewa Square is Nigeria's foremost ceremonial ground and games centre. Felmos Engineering carried out an in-situ non-destructive integrity test on all the structural members within the facility — the pavilion, the towers, the terrace and the office complex among them — working throughout with ultrasonic equipment so that a building of this standing was never cut into.

projects.title: St. Nicholas House
projects.location: 26 Catholic Mission Street, Lagos Island, Lagos
projects.scope: Integrity testing of a fifteen-floor high rise in continuous use as a hospital, offices and car park.
projects.narrative: St. Nicholas House is a fifteen-floor high-rise on Lagos Island housing a hospital, an office complex and a car park. Felmos Engineering tested the compressive strength of the structural elements in situ, floor by floor, without taking the building out of use — the whole survey ran non-destructively around an operating hospital.

projects.title: National Stadium, Surulere
projects.scope: Testing of the facility ahead of renovation.
projects.narrative: Built in 1972, the National Stadium is a major sports venue and a symbol of national pride. Felmos Engineering was commissioned to conduct a non-destructive test on the facility prior to renovation — establishing what the existing structure could still carry before anything was designed on top of it.

projects.client: Lagos State College of Nursing, Igando
projects.scope: Non-destructive testing of an existing sewage treatment plant.
projects.narrative: Felmos Engineering conducted a non-destructive test on the college's existing sewage treatment plant, working across the aeration, clarifier and effluent sections. projects.title: Dynamic Load Testing
projects.scope: Dynamic load tests on working piles, carried out on sites in Lagos State and Akwa Ibom.
projects.narrative: Dynamic load testing establishes the capacity of a pile already in the ground by measuring its response to a controlled impact, rather than by stacking kentledge on top of it. Felmos Engineering has carried these out on sites in Lagos State and in Akwa Ibom, with the site team briefed at the pile before each test.
